title: Windshields with cameras and driver-assist sensors.
intro: Many recent vehicles have a camera or sensors mounted at the windshield. Tell us about them up front, so this step is clear before your replacement is confirmed.

sections.title: Why it matters
body: Driver-assist features can rely on a camera mounted at the windshield. After a replacement, some vehicles need that system calibrated, which is known as ADAS calibration.

sections.title: What Vitreva does
body: Vitreva replaces windshields and does not perform ADAS calibration. If your vehicle needs it, we refer you to an appropriate provider and help clarify that step before confirming the replacement.

sections.title: What to tell us
body: You don’t need to know the technical details. Just share what you can see or what you already know about your vehicle.
list: Your vehicle’s year, make and model
Whether there’s a camera or sensor near the rearview mirror
Any driver-assist features you know of
A photo of the area behind the rearview mirror, if you’re not sure
